title: Engine Controls — Fire Handle — Install the Over-Centre Detent and the Hinged Guard
abstract: Fits an over-centre detent and a hinged guard to each engine fire handle, so that the handle has no stable partial position and cannot be reached by inadvertent contact during cockpit preparation.

sections.planning_reason: Two operators reported that the fire handle can be moved out of its stowed position without latching, leaving an ambiguous state in which the handle looks disturbed but no shut-off has been commanded. One handle was found part-pulled after a crew changeover and the aircraft was returned to stand. An inadvertent contact case was also reported during cockpit preparation with a flight bag on the pedestal. Neither event affected the engine, but a control of this criticality should have one defined position and no partial state.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin gives the instructions to replace the handle link with the item carrying the detent spring seat, to renew the tube assembly with the machined stop at the pulled position, and to install a hinged guard over the handle face. The guard must be lifted before the handle can be reached and falls clear when the handle is pulled. The microswitch block wiring is re-terminated because the switch actuation point moves 4 mm. The extinguishing discharge path and the bottle installation are unchanged.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Make the fire extinguishing system safe and confirm that the bottles are isolated. Drop the overhead panel and gain access to the four handle mechanisms. Remove the handle link and the tube assembly from the first handle. Install the replacement link with the detent spring seat and the tube assembly with the machined stop, and set the detent break-out force to the value given in AMM-T-76-20-11-200-002-A. Install the hinged guard with its fitting and confirm that it falls clear through the full pull. Re-terminate the microswitch block and check the actuation point against the reference on the handle bracket. Repeat for the remaining three handles; all four must be converted together. Restore the overhead panel. Do the fire handle functional test on all four positions, confirming that no stable intermediate position exists and that the microswitch makes only at full pull. Record the modification and issue the crew documentation supplement.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to TITAN-88 aircraft in the MSN T00001 to T00206 range, excluding MSN T00190 which has a non-standard overhead panel. Aircraft that have taken the dual position sensing standard are outside this effectivity, because the sensor target is carried on the tube assembly and that standard supersedes the arrangement installed here.
sections.material_note: Kit K7620-1008-01 covers one aircraft, all four handles. There is no long-lead item. Removed links and tube assemblies are returned for core credit. The guard is supplied assembled and must not be dismantled.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled A-check, or within 30 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
